text:
mia: @eng-runtime quick ask — marketing is finalizing a launch post and we need a last-minute gating check on benchmark claims. Can someone run a control cohort and confirm deltas vs previous runs? Need artifacts + repro steps. Target: EOD Thu.
ashwin: can do. will need acceptance criteria, exact sample set, and which model/quant variants to test. also confirm infra you want (hosted vs dedicated).
jordan: include both quantized-8bit and float16 variants — marketing claims call out quant numbers.
mia: acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 650ms on hosted config, median token cost within 8% of claimed number, and hallucination rate <= 0.5% on our QA eval. Sample set = marketing_launch_500.json, seed=2025, cohort size=500, stratify by short/med/long. payload link: https://internal/samples/marketing_launch_500.json (internal only).
nashwin: plan looks good. I'll schedule runs on dedicated-s-4 to avoid noisy neighbors. quick plan: (1) smoke run 50 samples, (2) full run 500 samples, (3) collect per-token heatmap + top-1% traces. config snippet I'll use:```yaml
cohort: marketing_control_v3
size: 500
seed: 2025
stratify: [short, medium, long]
warmup: true
quant_variants: [float16, q8]
```
runtime-bot: scheduled run ticket created: run_id=run-20250301-17, queue=dedicated-s-4, est_duration=2h. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/run-20250301-17
sam: for reproducibility we need the exact curl payload, headers, and server config (batch_size, max_tokens, kv_cache policy). please include KV warmup steps.
mia: minimal curl example for the doc: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @marketing_launch_500.json` — but please attach the exact payload and env used in the run.
lina: legal asked for sample provenance mapping (sample_id -> original_source). please include that with the artifacts.
nashwin: noted. I'll drop artifacts to /artifacts/marketing/run-20250301-17 and include a README with commands and checks. Preliminary timeline: smoke numbers in ~3h, full artifacts + traces in ~8h.
mia: can we get the smoke numbers within 3h? if yes we can update the launch deck for tomorrow.
nashwin: yes smoke in ~3h, full completion ~6h after that dependent on queue. I'll post status updates here.
jordan: :thumbsup: once run is done can we get a 1-slide summary comparing p50/p95/cost-per-1k for float16 vs q8? we want one chart for deck.
sam: I'll extract p50/p95, per-token cost, and produce a CSV + slide-ready chart. will also attach the top-1% traces for sample-level debugging.
mia: one more ask — embargo on raw samples: do not share outside Redwood. publish only aggregated numbers in the deck.
nashwin: understood. we'll mark artifacts internal and include provenance. README will call out embargo.
mia: thanks all — tagging @eng-runtime to prioritize. please ping here when smoke is uploaded. :pray:
runtime-bot: status update: smoke run started run-20250301-17-smoke, queued on dedicated-s-4-node-7.
nashwin: smoke complete. uploading quick summary: p50=210ms, p95=610ms, median_token_cost delta = +3.2% vs claimed. no major hallucination regressions on QA sample set (0.3%). uploading artifacts now. link: https://ci.internal/artifacts/marketing/run-20250301-17/smoke
mia: awesome — can you also attach the exact server flags used?
nashwin: flags: `--batch-size=8 --max-tokens=1024 --kv-cache=enabled --allocator=cuda` attached in README. full run starting in 20m.
mia: perfect, thanks everyone.
